files.dict_data_format: raw prefix bytes (19351 entries, 1-based ids; id 0 means no letter-only prefix)

storage_extensions.usage: MANDATORY: mmap codes.bin as `const uint16_t* mi_prefix_codes` of length 14835720, plus dict.offsets and dict.data. AT STARTUP: linear-scan dict.offsets+dict.data once to resolve `uint16_t japan_code` and `uint16_t usa_code` (the dict id whose bytes equal 'Japan' and 'USA' respectively; ids are 1-based). IN A NEW DEDICATED PHASE `build_M_prefix_bitset` (parallel sequential sweep over codes.bin): build `std::vector<uint64_t> M_prefix((N_mi+63)/64,0)` where bit r is set iff `mi_prefix_codes[r] == japan_code || mi_prefix_codes[r] == usa_code`. The build sweeps the 29.5MB codes column SEQUENTIALLY in 12-thread parallel chunks; output bitset is ~1.85MB (LLC-resident). IN PHASE `scan_mi_csr_M_prefix_first`: the inner-loop FIRST CHECK after computing `r = mit_row[k]` MUST be `if (!((M_prefix[r>>6] >> (r&63)) & 1ULL)) continue;` — BEFORE reading `mi_mid[r]`, BEFORE the Y bitset, BEFORE `mi_info_off[r]`. This rejects ~99.5% of the 8M-row CSR slice using a single cache-line read into a 1.85MB bitset, eliminating the dominant random probes into mi_movie_id (58MB), mi_info_off (118MB), and mi_info_dat (626MB) for all rejected rows. For survivors (~80K), proceed with mv = mi_mid[r], Y[mv] check, then read mi_info bytes and run `mi_info_match` (the existing memmem('200', tail) LIKE check, with prefix-length known: 6 for Japan:, 4 for USA:, distinguished by reading mi_prefix_codes[r] which is already in cache). If japan_code or usa_code resolves to 0 (not in dict), set it to a sentinel that won't match any row.

join_order.notes: Single cache-line bit test on ~1.85MB LLC-resident bitset BEFORE reading any wide mi columns. Rejects ~99.5% of the 8M slice.

mi rows passing M_prefix AND Y AND memmem('200', tail)

For each mv, walk mc range; require any cn_country_code[company_id-1]==cc_us; break on first hit.
Cheap int filters first (role_id==rt_actress, person_role_id != INT32_MIN), then P_and_an bit test, then varlen ci.note voice-set.

data_structures.dim_scalars: int32 ids for rt_actress, it_rd, cc_us, g_f; uint16 japan_code, usa_code resolved via one-time linear scan of prefix_dict.offsets+data.
data_structures.Y_year_bitset: vector<uint64_t> of (N_title+1) bits; bit mv set iff production_year[mv-1] > 2000 AND != INT32_MIN. ~316KB → L2.
data_structures.P_fused_bitset: vector<uint64_t> of (N_name+1) bits; bit pid set iff gender=='f' AND memmem(name,'An') AND an_off[pid+1] > an_off[pid]. ~520KB → L2.
data_structures.M_prefix_bitset: vector<uint64_t> of (N_mi+1) bits; bit r set iff mi_prefix_codes[r] == japan_code || mi_prefix_codes[r] == usa_code. ~1.85MB → LLC-resident.
data_structures.mi_prefix_codes_mmap: const uint16_t* over codes.bin (29.5MB); accessed SEQUENTIALLY during M_prefix build, then NEVER touched again during scan_mi.
data_structures.aggregation: two per-thread MIN accumulators (name_id, title_id); final reduce.

parallelism.morsel_unit: build_Y/P/M: #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static, 65536). M_prefix build sweeps codes.bin sequentially in 12 chunks. scan_mi_csr: #pragma omp for over k in [lo,hi) schedule(static, 4096). main_scan: parallel for over T schedule(static, 64). Per-thread local accumulators reduced at the end.

indexes.purpose: drive scan: iterate only release-dates mi rows

like_strategies.method: Step 1 (startup): linear-scan dict.offsets+dict.data once to resolve japan_code (entry bytes 'Japan', len 5) and usa_code (entry bytes 'USA', len 3); if not found set to UINT16_MAX sentinel. Step 2 (build_M_prefix_bitset phase, parallel sequential sweep over codes.bin): for each r in [0,N_mi), set M_prefix[r>>6] |= (1ULL << (r&63)) iff prefix_codes[r] == japan_code || prefix_codes[r] == usa_code. Step 3 (scan_mi_csr_M_prefix_first inner loop): test M_prefix[r] bit FIRST; only survivors read mi_movie_id, Y bitset, mi_info_off, mi_info_dat. Step 4 (LIKE finalization for survivors): re-read prefix_codes[r] (already cached); if code==japan_code, prefix_len=6, search 'Japan:' boundary then memmem('200',3) in suffix; if code==usa_code, prefix_len=4 similarly. memcmp the literal prefix bytes to be safe.

scan_mi_csr_filter_order: 1. k iterates sequentially; r = mit_row[k] (sequential read of rowids.bin)
2. FIRST CHECK: test M_prefix bitset at r — if NOT set, continue (skips ALL subsequent reads)
4. test Y bitset at mv — if NOT set, continue
5. read mi_info_off[r], mi_info_off[r+1]; if empty, continue
6. re-read mi_prefix_codes[r] (in L1 if recently read; otherwise just memcmp prefix bytes): pick prefix length (6 for Japan:, 4 for USA:); verify memcmp matches
7. require memmem('200', 3) in suffix bytes after the prefix
main_scan_filter_order: 1. mc range walk: require any cn_country_code[company_id-1]==cc_us; break on first hit
4. pid = ci.person_id; require P_and_an bit set (single L2-resident bit test)
5. require ci.note voice-set (varlen, only for rare survivors)
6. update local MIN(name) and (once per movie) MIN(title)
optimization_notes: Iter_2 best at 63ms with scan_mi=24ms (38% of total). Iter_3 (prescribe prefix check inside CSR loop) and iter_4 (sequential scan over all 14.8M mi rows) both regressed because the codegen either did not actually mmap codes.bin or did extra full-table work. Root cause: scan_mi makes 8M random/strided probes into mi_movie_id (58MB), mi_info_off (118MB), and mi_info_dat (626MB) — all greatly exceeding the 12MB L3. The prefix_codes column version already exists; the problem is integrating it correctly. Strategy: Category B (algorithm change) + Category E (use existing storage extension). Make the prefix filter a DEDICATED separate phase build_M_prefix_bitset that sequentially sweeps the 29.5MB codes.bin once (parallel, ~1-2ms) and produces a 1.85MB LLC-resident bitset M_prefix over mi rows. The CSR walk then tests M_prefix[r] as its FIRST inner-loop operation, BEFORE reading mi_movie_id[r], Y, or any varlen mi.info bytes. The ~99.5% of CSR-slice rows that fail the prefix filter incur exactly one cache-line read into the small bitset — no probes into the L3-exceeding columns. Expected: scan_mi drops from 24ms to ~3-6ms; build_M_prefix adds ~1-2ms. Net gain ~17-20ms; total ~43-48ms. Making M_prefix a separate named phase forces codegen to actually mmap codes.bin and use it — distinct from the previously failed inline-check approach. Year threshold 2000 and the four voice-note strings are preserved verbatim.
